evidence.title: Suno: Make a Full Song From a Simple Idea

name: Suno
summary: Turns a text prompt into a complete original song with vocals, lyrics and production.
description: Describe a song or paste lyrics and Suno returns a finished track with vocals and instruments, then offers remix, extend, stem separation, a browser DAW (Suno Studio), voice recording and custom models trained on your own recordings. Free tier with daily songs; Pro and Premier unlock commercial rights, downloads and studio tools. Web, iOS and Android.
contains: free tier: up to 10 songs a day, no credit card
Pro $8 and Premier $24 per month with annual billing
Pro: 20 song downloads a month; Premier: 60
Suno Studio browser DAW with MIDI export, effects and automation
stem separation into vocal and instrument stems, up to 3 types
voices: record a few seconds and sing anything in any style
custom models trained on your own recordings
